IS 13128 : Part 1 : 1991 Textiles - Fabric, woven glass fibre, for electrical insulation and plastic laminate - Specification Part 1 Loomstate fabricsUDC 677.52 : 621.315.614.1TXD 33Reaffirmed 20191 Scope1.1 This standard (Part 1) specifies the requirements of loomstate glassfibre fabrics manufactured from continuous filament yarn of `E type glass.These fabrics are suitable for use in production of coated/treated fabrics forelectrical insulation purposes including those required for making laminates(clad or unclad) for printed circuit boards.1.2 This standard does not cover tapes and fabrics intended for use primarilyin reinforced plastic laminates.2 ReferencesIS 1963 :1981Methods for determination of threads per unitlength inwoven fabricsIS 2303 : 1963 Method of grading glass for alkalinityIS 3919 :1966Methods for sampling cotton fabrics fordeterminationphysical characteristicsIS 4905 : 1968Methods for random samplingIS 5463 :1969Methods for sampling of cotton fabrics forchemicalcharacteristicsIS 6359 :1971Methods for conditioning of textilesIS 7702 :1975Methods for determination of thickness of wovenandknitted fabricsIS 11916 :1986Continuous filament textile glass yarn for aerospacepurposesSP 45 :1988Handbook on glossary of textile terms
